zh.explain: 像鹍鸟在秋季转化变成大鹏，快乐地在天空中遨游。青云直上，出类拔萃，其余的飞禽都赶不上。
divination: 只有鹍这种鸟能化为大鹏，其他的飞禽都不能。
到时攀折桂枝，登上高位，自然会增禄增福。
zh.summary: 此卦鹍鹏兴变之象。所祈求之事有所变动则会非常吉祥。

verse: Come Autumn, the partridge will transform into a Roc.
With great joy and cheer, it flies up.
Soaring high and higher among the clouds,
Beyond the reach of many other fowls.
interpretation: A partridge is transformed into a Roc – something not for every bird.  Pluck a branch from the heavenly tree and your wealth and fortune will multiply on their own.
meaning: A partridge is transformed into a Roc.  A dramatic change will bring great fortune.
en.explain: In autumn, a partridge is transformed into a large Roc, soaring joyfully in the air, straight up the sky, excelling, which the other birds could not catch up with.
divination: Only a partridge can transform into a Roc but no other birds can. When the time comes to ascend to a high position, wealth and blessings will keep on growing naturally.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh item 家宅情况 is followed by a semicolon-like mark (；) instead of ：on the page; normalized as key/value. 鹍 read from image (bird radical; standard form of this poem). zh 投资理财 says 秋天 (autumn) but en says 'Favorable in Spring' — copied as printed.
